Initial release of error-message-improver skill.

- Provides structured workflow and templates to create clearer, actionable error messages.
- Supports developers, support teams, and SaaS operators in troubleshooting and user feedback tasks.
- Delivers tailored answers, reusable checklists, or workflows for repeatable tasks.
- Validates outputs against clear criteria, ensuring actionable and understandable results.
- Includes trigger keywords and example prompts for easy integration.
